# AlgoDaily

> > AlgoDaily is a comprehensive software interview preparation platform offering daily coding challenges, structured curriculum, and company-specific interview guides across multiple programming languages.

AlgoDaily provides aspiring software engineers with a complete toolkit for technical interview success, featuring algorithm visualizations, video tutorials, and real interview questions from major tech companies. The platform combines daily practice challenges with curated learning paths covering data structures, algorithms, systems design, and machine learning fundamentals.

## Key Topics

- Coding Interview Preparation
- Data Structures
- Algorithms
- Systems Design
- Technical Interview Prep
- Python
- JavaScript
- SQL
- Binary Search Trees
- Algorithm Challenges
- Career Development
- Interview Questions
- Job Preparation
- OOP Design
- Machine Learning Fundamentals

## Core Learning Platform

- [AlgoDaily Home](https://algodaily.com): AlgoDaily homepage: interview prep platform with daily coding challenges
- [Daily Coding Challenges](https://algodaily.com/challenges/daily): Daily coding challenges with multi-language support and visualization in JavaScript, Python, Java, and SQL
- [Curriculum and Courses](https://algodaily.com/curriculum): Structured learning paths covering data structures, algorithms, systems design, and advanced topics
- [Video Library](https://algodaily.com/videos): Video tutorials and algorithm pattern lessons with coding walkthroughs

## Company Interview Guides

- [Companies Directory](https://algodaily.com/companies): Directory of tech companies with interview questions and processes
- [Dell Interview Guide](https://algodaily.com/companies/dell): Dell company guide: interview questions, process, and data structures preparation
- [Hudson River Trading Interview Guide](https://algodaily.com/companies/hudson-river-trading): Hudson River Trading guide: interview questions and technical preparation strategies
- [Amplitude Interview Guide](https://algodaily.com/companies/amplitude): Amplitude company guide: interview questions and technical interview preparation
